preserve: Keep copying scoped to the genuine account and resource; use the canonical record sync, history, erasure and request-answer owners.
Bound each page and long message, verify carried state before completion, and keep an incomplete carry recoverable.
A joining copy must catch up and hold the authority material its signed placement permits before answering; fresh caller authorization remains with account routes.
Fan out messages independently so a non-answering peer does not serialize delivery to other peers.
allowed_deltas: The retired copy follower sends freshness notices; Rust carries records and acknowledgement stamps through an injected Link. Voter-majority claims, renewable writer terms, durable term floors, rollback of unacknowledged writes and joint membership acknowledgement are later native behavior, not a one-to-one port of the retired read-only replica.

Signed placement distinguishes copy keepers, may-answer computers and voters. Only may-answer computers receive sign-in rows and the account root; other copies receive sealed records. Rekeying distributes a new root only to computers still allowed to answer; previously disclosed plaintext and old roots cannot be revoked by that operation. Existing sign-in, record sync, sealing and writer_row modules retain their ownership.

A claim waits for a voter majority, catches every newer heard resource and placement before voting, then recounts respondents against current voters. Bootstrap stamps_of_all retains full-peer collection. Membership adoption preserves a concurrently valid renewal while explicit releases invalidate stale results through epoch.

Carry from a shared record book into resource-owned files holds the source snapshot and pristine destination write reservation through page/readback checks, commits whole or rolls back, and retries an incomplete pass on the existing timer. Settlement retains the earliest pending log boundary.
Read the cached signed placement row and genuine public account key for native announcements without reacquiring a foreground request owner; do not alter fresh caller admission.

Keep engine-generic replication, carry and placement. Drop the retired region selector, central store authority, Worker/Durable Object service, JS runtime and product-specific read routing under docs/PRINCIPLES.md.
